newsitem.title: USA: Halifax Corp sees Q4 income minimal.
newsitem.headline: Halifax Corp sees Q4 income minimal.

text.p: Halifax Corp said Wednesday it expects minimal net income for the fourth quarter ended March 31, mainly because of unexpected losses on a new line of major printer maintenance contracts.
First Call estimates were not immediately available, but in 1996 the company reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.30 per share on revenues of just under $18 million.

The technology services and facilities services company expects about $18 million in revenue for the quarter and about $76 million in revenue for the year. The company's full year 1996 revenues were about $47 million.

The company said it believed major new contracts for its printer maintenance segment would make a modest contribution to fourth quarter income, but profits did not materialize during this start-up phase.
It said it has cut initial losses in this area and expects the business to be operating at a profit by the end of first quarter of fiscal 1998.
